speakers.name: Mingke Luo
speakers.role: Speaker (founder per agenda; role not stated in transcript)
speakers.background: Founded a personal-agent startup ~2016 ('AI Concierge') that used AI for intent understanding and a ~20-person call center as 'human APIs' for fulfillment; it failed. Pivoted to enterprise agents: built the Visa Concierge (2017) and, over eight years, enterprise agents for BMW, Porsche, Intel etc.; built an Intelligent Personal Assistant (IPA) for BMW and in 2019 enabled framework-agnostic communication between departmental agents within one organization. Splits time between San Francisco and Shanghai.
